chapter.verse: Zeisu Oliv Mual ah a pai hi.
Zingsang tungin biakna innpi-ah a paikik leh, mi khempeuh ama kiangah hong pai uh a, Zeisu in tua mite thu a hilh hi.
Laitheite leh Farisaite in numei khat pasal tawh a mawh laitak a muh uh ciangin, manin hong paipih uh a, mite lai zangah a koih khit uh ciangin,
“Sia aw, hih numei a khialh laitak kimu hi.
Thukhamna sungah hih bang mi, ‘Suang tawh deenglum un,’ ci-in Moses in thu hong vaikhak hi. Ahih hangin nang bang na ci hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Tua bang a cih uh ciangin, Zeisu tungah mawhna zon’ nadingun ci-in a ze-et uh hi. Ahih hangin Zeisu kun a, a khutme tawh leiah lai a gelh hi.
Amaute in a dot sawnsawn uh ciangin ding a, “Note lakah mawh nei lo mi khat in numei suang tawh deeng masa hen,” a cih khit ciangin,
khatvei kun kikin a khutme tawh leiah a gelh hi.
Tua thu a zak uh ciangin, a teekpen pan a khangnopen dongin khat nungah khat a paikhia uh hi. Zeisu guak om a, numei zong a lai zangah a om hi.
Zeisu ding kik a, “Numei aw, amaute koi lai-ah a om uh hiam? Kuamah in nang thu hong khen lo hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Numei in, “Kuamah in hong khen lo hi, Topa aw,” a ci hi. Zeisu in, “Ke’n zong kong khen kei ding hi. Pai in la, a nung ciangin na mawh nawn kei in,” a ci hi.
Khatvei Zeisu in, “Keimah in hih leitung khuavak ka hi hi. Ka nung hong zuite in khuamial lakah pai loin nuntakna khuavak a ngah ding hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Farisaite in, “Nang ading nangma’n teci na pang hi. Na teci pan’na aman kei hi,” a ci uh hi.

Zeisu in, “Keimah in kei ading teci ka pan’ hangin ka teci pan’na a man hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keimah in koi lam pan hong pai a, koi lamah ka pai ding cih ka thei hi. Note in ahih leh, koi lam pan hong pai a, koi lamah ka pai ding cih na thei kei uh hi.
Note in si leh sa khen bangin thu na khen uh a; kei in kuamah thu ka khen kei hi.
Ahi hi. Keimah in thu ka khen zongin ka thukhenna a man hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keimah guak ka hi kei hi; kei hong sawl Pa in kei tawh a omkhawm hi.
Ahi hi; teci nih a om leh, thu aman hi ci-in note Thukhamna lai sungah kigelh hi.
Keimah in keima ading teci ka pang hi. A hong sawl Pa in keima a ding teci a pang hi,” ci-in a gen hi.

Tua hi-a amaute in, “Na Pa koi lai-ah om hiam?” ci-a a dot uh ciangin Zeisu in, “Note in kei nong theih kei uh leh, ka Pa zong na thei kei ding uh hi. Kei nong theih uh leh, ka Pa zong na thei ding uh hi,” a ci kik hi.
Biakna innpi sungah thu a hilh lai takin, sumkholna dei sungah hih thu a gen hi. A hun tung nai lo ahih ciangin kuamah in a man kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin khatvei Zeisu in, “Kei ka ciah ding hi. Note in nong zon’ uh hangin nomau mawhna sungah na si ding uh hi. Ka paina mun nong tung zo kei ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah mite in, ‘Ka paina mun nong tung zo kei ding uh hi,” ci ahih ciangin amahmah kithat ding hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Note in nuailam mi na hi uh hi. Kei in tunglam mi ka hi hi. Note in hih leitung pan a piang na hi uh hi. Kei in hih leitung pan a piang ka hi kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, nomau mawhna sungah na si ding uh hi kong ci hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keimah in tua pa ka hih lam na up kei uh leh, nomau mawhna sungah na si ding uh hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in, “Nang kua na hi hiam?” ci-in a dot uh ciangin Zeisu in, “Keimah in a cil pek panin note kiangah kong gen bangin ka hi hi,
Note tungah gen ding leh khen ding thu tampi ka nei hi; ahih hangin kei hong sawlpa in thumanpa ahi hi. Ama kiang pan ka zak bang bekin leitung mite kiangah ka hilh hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in Pa thu a gen ahih lam a thei kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu in, “Note in Mihing Tapa na khaitoh khit uh ciangin, tua pa ka hih leh ka deih bang hih loin ka Pa in hong sinsak bangin hih thu ka gen hi cih note’n na thei ding uh hi.
Kei hong sawlpa in kei tawh a omkhawm hi. Amah in kei hong nusia kei ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama deihna bangin ka hih tawntung hi,” a ci hi.
Tua thu a gen lai takin mi tampi in a um uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Zeisu in amah a um Judah mite kiangah, “Ka thuhilhna na zuih uh leh ka nungzui taktakte na hi ding uh hi.
Thuman taktak zong na thei ding uh a, tua thuman thutak in note hong suaktasak ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Tuate in, “Kote in Abraham’ suante ka hi uh hi. Cikmah hunin mi’ sila-in ka om ngei kei uh hi. Note hong suaktasak ding hi, bang hangin ci na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong kik uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Aman takpi kong cih-inah, ‘Mawhna a bawlte khempeuh in mawhna’ sila ahi uh hi.
Sila in inn sungah a om tawntung kei hi; ahih hangin tapa ahih leh a om tawntung hi.
Tua ahih ciangin, Tapa in note hong suahtaksak leh suaktate taktak na hi ding uh hi.
Note in Abraham’ suante na hih uh ka thei hi. Ahih hangin, ka thuhilhna in note sungah om nading ngah lo ahih ciangin note in thah dingin kei nong zong uh hi.
Keimah in ka Pa kiangah ka muh bangin kong hilh hi. Note in zong na pa uh kiangah na zak bangun na gamta uh hi,” a ci hi.
Amaute in, “Ka pa uh Abraham ahi hi,” a ci uh hi. Zeisu in zong, “Note in Abraham’ suan na hih uh leh, Abraham gamtat bangin na gamta ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin ka Pa kiangah ka zak bangin note kiangah thuman thutak hong hilhpa keimah thah dingin tu-in na hong zong uh hi. Abraham in tua bangin a gamta kei hi.
Note in na pa uh a gamtat bangin na gamta uh hi,” a ci hi. Amaute in, “Kote in zawlta ka hi kei uh hi; Pasian kici Pa khat bek ka nei uh hi,” a ci uh hi.

Zeisu in, “Pasian in note’ Pa ahih takpi leh, note in kei nong it ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keimah in Pasian kiang pan hong pusuakin kong pai hi. Keima ut bangin kong pai kei hi, Amah in kei hong sawl hi.
Bang hangin ka thu thei lo na hi uh hiam? Ka thuhilhna ngai nuam lo na hih uh ciangin, ka thu na thei kei uh hi.

Note in na pa uh dawimangpa’ suan na hi uh hi. A gilo na pa uh deihna bangin na gamta nuam uh hi. Amah in a cil panin mi thatpa hi a, thumanna nei lo ahih ciangin thuman thutak sungah a kip kei ding hi. Amah in thuzuau a gen ciangin ama thu a gen hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in zuauthu gen leh thuzuaupa lah ahi hi.
Thuman thutak ka gen ciangin ka thu na um kei uh hi.
Ka tungah mawhna a om hi ci-in note lakah kua in hong lak ahi hiam? Keimah in thuman thutak hilh ka hih leh, bang dingin kei hong um lo na hi uh hiam?
Pasian tawh a kipawlte in Pasian’ thu a ngai thei hi. Note in Pasian tawh kipawl lo na hih uh ciangin ka thu na ngai kei uh hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
Judah mite in, “Nang Samaria mi na hi a, dawilawm nei na hi kong cihna uh man hilo ahi hiam?” a ci kik uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Keimah in dawilawm nei ka hi kei hi. Ka Pa ka zahtak a, note in kei nong simmawh uh hi.
Ahih hangin keimah in minthan’na ka zong kei hi. Ka minthan’ nading a zong thukhen ding khat a om hi.
Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, mi khatpeuh in ka thu a ngaih leh, sihna tawh a tawntungin a kipelh ding hi,” a ci hi.
Judah mite in, “Nang dawilawm nei na hi ci-in tu-in ka thei uh hi. Abraham akipan kamsangte a si khin zo uh hi. Nang in, ‘Mi khatpeuh in keima thu a ngaih leh, sihna a thuak kei ding hi,’ na ci hi.
A sisa ka pa uh Abraham sangin lianzaw na hi hiam? Pasian’ kamsangte zong a si zo uh hi. Nang kua lima kibawl na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Keima minthan’na kong lah leh, ka minthan’na a mawkna ahi ding hi. Ka min a thangsakpa in ka Pa ahi hi. Tua Pa in, ‘Kote Pasian ahi hi,’ na cihpa uh ahi hi.
Note in tua Pasian na thei kei uh hi. Ahih hangin ke’n ahih leh, ka thei hi. Ka thei kei hi ci leng, note bangin zuauthu gen ka hi ding hi. Ahih hangin tua Pasian thei-in ama thu ka ngai hi.
Na pa uh Abraham in keima ni a mu nuam hi. A mu-a a lungdam mahmah hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah mite in, “Kum sawmnga zong na pha nai kei hi. Abraham mu zo na hi hiam?” a ci uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Ke’n aman takpi kong cih-inah, Abraham’ pian’ ma-in kei ka om hi,” a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amaute in Zeisu suang tawh deeng dingin suang tawm uh a, ahih hangin Zeisu bu-in biakna innpi sung pan a paikhia hi.
